passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: Please read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes included under Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Forward-looking statements are statements that attempt to forecast or anticipate future developments in our business, financial condition, or results of operations. When reviewing the discussion below, you should keep in mind the substantial risks and uncertainties that could impact our business. In particular, we encourage you to review the risks and uncertainties described in "Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors" included elsewhere in this report. These risks and uncertainties could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected in forward-looking statements contained in this report or implied by past results and trends. Forward-looking statements, like all statements in this report, speak only as of their date (unless another date is indicated), and we undertake no obligation to update or revise these statements in light of future developments. See the section titled "Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" in this report. This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussion of 2023 and year-over-year comparisons between 41 Table of Contents Unity Software Inc. fiscal 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found under the heading "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operation" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, that was filed with the SEC on February 21, 2025, and are incorporated by reference herein. Overview Unity offers a suite of tools to develop, deploy, and grow games and interactive experiences across all major platforms from mobile, PC, and console, to extended reality (XR). Our platform consists of two complementary sets of solutions: Create Solutions and Grow Solutions. Starting in the fourth quarter of 2023, we began to reset our product and service offerings to focus on our core businesses, which we refer to as our "Strategic Portfolio": primarily, the Unity Engine and related consumption services, and monetization solutions. Recent Developments in Our Business In the year ended December 31, 2025, we had reductions to our workforce and our office footprint, that resulted in approximately $33 million in employee separation costs, and $14 million of non-employee charges associated with these reductions. We will continue to evaluate our facility needs. For additional details, refer to the section titled "Risk Factors." passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations, and Industry We have a history of losses and may not achieve or sustain profitability on a GAAP basis in the future. We have experienced significant net losses on a GAAP basis in each period since inception. In addition, our revenue has varied and, in certain periods, declined and could vary or decline in the future. We are not certain whether we will achieve or maintain profitability in the future. Our costs and expenses may increase in the long term on a GAAP basis, which could negatively affect our future results of operations. In addition, our investments in areas such as: • research and development, including investments in our engineering teams and in further differentiating our platform, as well as the development of new solutions and features; • our sales and marketing organizations to engage our existing and prospective customers, increase brand awareness and drive adoption and expansion of our platform and solutions; • initiatives to grow our presence in new or adjacent industries and use cases beyond the gaming industry; • our technology infrastructure, including systems architecture, hosting, scalability, availability, performance, and security; • acquisitions or strategic investments; • global expansion or restructuring; and • our general and administration organization, including legal, IT, and accounting expenses, will vary from period to period, which will impact our costs and ability to achieve and maintain profitability. Even if such investments increase our revenue, any such increase may not be enough to offset any increase in operating expenses. Cost-cutting efforts, such as discontinuing certain product offerings, reducing our workforce or reducing our office footprint, may not be effective or may not be effective on the timelines or to the extent we expect. Our past results may not be indicative of future operating performance. You should not rely on our past results of operations as indicators of future performance. Overall growth of our revenue is difficult to predict and depends, in part, on our ability to execute on enhancing our artificial intelligence (“AI”) capabilities and data infrastructure, our ongoing business realignment, and other growth strategies. You should evaluate our prospects in light of the risks and uncertainties frequently encountered by growing companies in rapidly evolving markets. These risks and uncertainties include challenges in accurate financial planning as a result of limited historical data relevant to the current scale and scope of our business and the recent changes to our business and operating model. If we are not able to grow efficiently, and manage our costs, we may not achieve profitability on a GAAP basis. We aim to achieve and maintain profitability on a GAAP basis. To do so, we need to continuously improve our platform’s capabilities, features and functionality. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow has risen steadily across the three-year trend while operating losses narrowed, showing the cost reset is converting accounting losses into cash generation. Cash conversion is the core support for the convertible debt stack, though the improvement rests on continued expense discipline rather than revenue growth.

Liquidity is a genuine strength: cash balances nearly cover the entire convertible debt stack, and the current ratio sits modestly above the sector median and comfortably above one. This gives the issuer room to address maturities without relying on refinancing markets.

key_risks.text: The issuer discloses a history of significant GAAP net losses in every period since inception and cannot assure profitability, with revenue having varied and declined in certain periods. Cost-cutting through workforce and office footprint reductions may not deliver the expected savings on the anticipated timeline.

The debt stack is entirely convertible notes, split between a current portion and a long-dated portion, so refinancing and conversion dynamics rather than amortisation drive the maturity profile. A meaningful slice falls due within the coming year, concentrating refinancing and settlement risk in a single instrument type.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative and far below the sector median, because operating income remains a loss against a modest but real cash interest bill. Coverage improved year on year as losses narrowed, yet debt service still depends on cash generation rather than earnings.

Free cash flow covers a meaningful slice of debt and improved year on year, but remains well below the sector median on the same measure. Capital expenditure is light, so nearly all operating cash converts to free cash flow, and buybacks were nil, leaving cash available for debt.

overall_credit_view.text: Leverage ratios are not meaningful given negative EBITDA, so the credit must be judged on liquidity and cash flow. Net debt is small relative to cash generation, and cash flow to net debt sits far above the next risk-band boundary, indicating substantial headroom on a net-debt basis.

Our view is stable but conditional: the balance sheet can absorb the near-term convertible maturity, yet sustained negative operating margins and a distress-zone Altman score mean the profile hinges on continued cash generation and successful conversion or refinancing of the notes.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流在三年趨勢中穩步上升，同時營運虧損收窄，顯示成本重組正將會計虧損轉化為現金生成。現金轉換是可換股債券結構的核心支撐，惟改善取決於持續的費用紀律而非收入增長。
流動性為真正優勢：現金結餘幾乎覆蓋整個可換股債券結構，而流動比率略高於行業中位數，並穩健地高於一。這為發行人提供空間處理到期債務，而無需依賴再融資市場。

key_risks.text: 發行人披露自成立以來每個期間均有重大GAAP淨虧損的歷史，且無法保證盈利能力，收入在某些期間有所波動並下降。透過裁減人手及縮減辦公空間以削減成本，未必能按預期時間表實現預期節省。
債務結構全為可換股票據，分為流動部分及長年期部分，因此到期結構由再融資及轉換動態而非攤銷驅動。相當部分將於來年到期，將再融資及結算風險集中於單一工具類型。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率為深度負值，遠低於行業中位數，因營運收入仍為虧損，而現金利息支出雖屬溫和但真實存在。覆蓋率隨虧損收窄而按年改善，惟償債仍依賴現金生成而非盈利。
自由現金流覆蓋債務的相當部分，並按年改善，但按同一指標仍遠低於行業中位數。資本開支較輕，因此幾乎所有營運現金均轉化為自由現金流，且回購為零，留下現金可用於債務。

overall_credit_view.text: 鑑於EBITDA為負，槓桿比率不具意義，因此信貸須以流動性及現金流判斷。淨債務相對於現金生成規模較小，而現金流對淨債務遠高於下一風險區間邊界，顯示按淨債務基準有相當充裕的緩衝。
我們的觀點為穩定但附帶條件：資產負債表可吸收近期的可換股到期債務，惟持續負值的營運利潤率及處於困境區間的Altman分數，意味著其狀況取決於持續的現金生成及票據的成功轉換或再融資。
